home.title: Home - OFS
paragraphs: Strategic Support for Marine, Offshore, Energy & Industrial Facility Operations
OFS delivers end-to-end sourcing and shipping solutions, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery of industrial goods.
OFS delivers end-to-end support for Engineering and EPC projects, ensuring efficient procurement, logistics, and project coordination to meet quality and timelines.
OFS delivers facility management procurement solutions, streamlining sourcing for maintenance and services to enhance efficiency.
OFS provides reliable sourcing of high-quality industrial spare parts, ensuring minimal downtime and uninterrupted operations.
OFS delivers end-to-end supply chain solutions, optimising procurement and inventory to enhance operational efficiency.
OFS offers location-based warehousing to ensure timely availability, accurate inventory, and smooth distribution of industrial goods.
OFS offers procurement support for logistics and shipping needs, ensuring timely delivery and cost-effective transportation solutions.
OFS ensures product quality through inspections and compliance, meeting industry standards and client requirements.

With a network of over 3,000+ internationally approved brands from the US and Europe, OFS ensures exceptional quality, reliability, and compliance with global industry standards in every solution we deliver.

We specialize in Spare Parts Procurement, ensuring the timely sourcing and delivery of high-quality components essential for the maintenance and operation of industrial systems and equipment. Our services include identifying reliable suppliers, managing purchase orders, handling international logistics, and ensuring compliance with technical specifications and industry standards.

We provide comprehensive Logistics and Shipping solutions that ensure the efficient movement of goods across local and international markets. Our services cover end-to-end supply chain management. With a focus on reliability, cost-effectiveness, and timely execution, we leverage advanced tracking technologies and global networks to streamline operations and meet the evolving demands of our clients across diverse industries.

We offer end-to-end Integrated Facility Management (IFM) services designed to optimize operations, reduce costs, and enhance the performance of built environments. Our solutions encompass maintenance, security, cleaning, energy management, and workplace services, all coordinated through a single point of contact. By integrating people, processes, and technology, we ensure seamless facility operations that support our clients’ core business objectives while maintaining high standards of safety, sustainability, and compliance.

We provide comprehensive Engineering and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) Support Services designed to enhance project efficiency, reduce risks, and ensure successful delivery across all phases of development. Our expertise spans detailed engineering design, procurement assistance, construction planning, and technical consulting—tailored to meet the unique demands of each client and industry. Whether supporting standalone engineering tasks or integrated EPC projects, we deliver reliable, scalable solutions that ensure compliance with international standards.

We offer integrated Procurement and Shipping services that streamline the sourcing, purchasing, and delivery of materials and equipment across global supply chains. Our end-to-end solutions cover vendor management, order processing, international logistics, customs clearance, and timely shipment coordination. By combining strategic procurement practices with efficient shipping operations, we help clients reduce costs, minimize delays, and ensure the reliable supply of critical goods to support project and operational success.
Our Commitment to Excellence and Innovation
Provide exceptional services that exceed client expectations
Implement cutting-edge technologies to enhance efficiency.
Build lasting relationships for mutual growth and success.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management

OFS is a leading Indian multinational enterprise renowned for delivering specialized Procurement and Technical Support Services across a wide array of industries. With unwavering commitment to precision, speed, and excellence, OFS stands as a trusted partner for clients worldwide.

Our core strength lies in combining deep technical expertise with strategic sourcing capabilities, offering end-to-end customized solutions that are both cost-efficient and operationally impactful. We support clients across project lifecycles, from engineering procurement to on-site delivery, ensuring seamless execution under the highest standards of quality, safety, and compliance.
We proudly serve a diverse portfolio of industries, including:

By leveraging our vast global network, technical soundness, and commitment to excellence, we provide clients with smart, scalable, and future-ready procurement solutions. From sourcing complex instrumentation and control systems to delivering critical industrial supplies, OFS ensures timely delivery, cost control, and uncompromising quality.
Driven by innovation and guided by integrity, OFS continues to redefine procurement excellence—empowering industries to operate smarter, faster, and stronger.

We uphold the highest ethical standards in every aspect of our business. Integrity means being transparent, and honest, in our interactions, ensuring trust and long-lasting relationships with our clients, partners, and employees.

We are committed to delivering the highest quality in every project we undertake. Our pursuit of excellence drives us to continuously improve, innovate, and exceed expectations, ensuring superior service and value for our clients.

We believe in the power of teamwork—both within our company and with our clients and partners. By fostering a collaborative environment, we combine diverse skills, ideas, and perspectives to drive the best possible outcomes for all stakeholders.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management

To provide world-class, customized solutions in Marine & Offshore Services, Engineering Procurement, Maintenance, AMC, and Facility Management. We aim to empower clients globally by integrating cutting-edge technology, efficient systems, and expert manpower — while ensuring top-tier Catering and Hospitality solutions that elevate workforce well-being and performance.

To be a globally recognized leader in delivering end-to-end engineering, procurement, facility, and project support solutions — driven by innovation, reliability, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management

OFS is a leading procurement and logistics company specializing in industrial sourcing solutions for a diverse range of industries, including aviation maintenance, oil & gas, petroleum refining, and marine & heavy engineering. As a trusted procurement partner, OFS delivers comprehensive procurement and supply chain management services that ensure the timely and efficient on-site delivery of industrial products and spare parts. Our solutions are designed to optimize operational efficiency, reduce costs, and simplify the procurement process, making OFS a vital contributor to your supply chain success.

At OFS , every shipment is meticulously tracked to ensure timely and accurate fulfilment. As part of our comprehensive procurement and logistics services, we thoroughly inspect each order for quality and quantity before preparing shipping documents. We ensure all materials are packed and labeled in strict accordance with the client’s purchase order instructions. With deep expertise in procurement and supply chain management, OFS delivers a seamless, end-to-end experience—from sourcing to final delivery.

At OFS , our ongoing collaboration with clients consistently delivers significant cost savings through a structured and strategic procurement approach. We efficiently manage both procurement and logistics operations, integrating cost-effective budgeting and competitive bidding processes that ensure quality compliance and reliable vendor performance.

At OFS , our procurement strategies within supply chain management encompass multiple stages of strategic sourcing and continuous capability enhancement. These are powered by our cloud-based, custom-built SCM software developed on Microsoft technologies. We offer procurement as a service—managing the complete process from industrial sourcing to logistics—ensuring optimal efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and accuracy for every purchase order.

At OFS , we empower our clients to achieve greater efficiency and measurable savings through effective procurement strategies that deliver faster results. From sourcing industrial valves, drilling equipment, maintenance tools, rotary equipment, to pumps, our comprehensive supply chain procurement process ensures access to top-quality products at competitive prices.

An efficient logistics and shipping strategy is essential for reducing costs, streamlining operations, and supporting sustainable business growth. In today’s fast-paced global economy—driven by globalization and the expansion of emerging markets—understanding logistics as a service is more critical than ever.

Outsourcing logistics management goes far beyond simply arranging transportation. It involves a comprehensive service offering that may include warehousing, order processing, inventory management, packing, assembly or final assembly, and vendor coordination. These integrated solutions create a more agile and effective supply chain.
Submission of offers for request for quotation
Supply chain setup for each purchase order
Acting as a procurement consultant and agent for clients on a fixed fee basis
Evaluation and selection of the global vendor base
Introduction of manufacturers for specific ventures, with technical and commercial review assistance

As a leading shipping logistics company, OFS delivers comprehensive procurement and logistics solutions, expertly handling all types of cargo with precision and care. Our end-to-end supply chain management services cover air, ocean, and road transport, offering tailored delivery solutions that emphasize safety, speed, and reliability.
OFS provides a wide range of logistics, procurement, and supply chain management services, including:
Selection of optimal transport modes and methods
Delivery to designated addresses or nominated freight forwarders
Interim inspections, technical support, and cost tracking

headings: Your Trusted Partner in High-Impact Technical Solutions
Connect with us today for partnerships, RFQs, or technical consultations.
paragraphs: At Oriented Facility Solution Pvt Ltd (OFS Group), we offer specialized engineering, integration, and field services that address the complex and high-performance needs of critical industrial environments. Our services are designed to support clients through every phase of their project lifecycle—from concept development and design to implementation, commissioning, and ongoing maintenance. With a focus on operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and technological innovation, we deliver tailored solutions that drive long-term success and growth. Our experienced teams bring technical expertise, industry knowledge, and a commitment to quality and safety, ensuring that every project is executed with precision, reliability, and resilience in today’s demanding market.

With a network of over 3,000+ internationally approved brands from the US and Europe, OFS ensures exceptional quality, reliability, and compliance with global industry standards in every solution we deliver.

Our trained teams ensure a spotless and welcoming environment at all times:
Hard Services- Keeping Your Infrastructure Running Smoothly

Technical & Compliance Management Driven by Data. Backed by Expertise.

SOffshore & Remote Site Facility Support Logistics-Backed. Globally Compliant.

Skilled Manpower Deployment People Make the Difference

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management

An efficient logistics and shipping strategy is essential for reducing costs, streamlining operations, and supporting sustainable business growth. In today’s fast-paced global economy—driven by globalization and the expansion of emerging markets—understanding logistics as a service is more critical than ever.

Outsourcing logistics management goes far beyond simply arranging transportation. It involves a comprehensive service offering that may include warehousing, order processing, inventory management, packing, assembly or final assembly, and vendor coordination. These integrated solutions create a more agile and effective supply chain.

At OFS, our procurement consultants bring a deep understanding of sourcing best practices combined with extensive experience in vendor management. We work closely with your team to analyze existing sourcing processes, identify areas for cost reduction, and uncover opportunities for measurable improvement. Through a strategic approach to indirect procurement, we help you streamline operations, enhance value, and drive sustainable business growth.

Procurement and logistics are the starting point of the supply chain, involving the sourcing, storage, and movement of essential materials. Logistics experts help reduce costs by optimizing transportation and procurement processes, ensuring smooth operations and greater efficiency.

Think of Supply Chain Management (SCM) as the recipe, and logistics as just one ingredient. While both focus on moving goods from origin to destination, SCM provides the overall strategy for sourcing, production, and delivery. Logistics ensures that everything arrives at the right place, at the right time—executing the plan SCM creates.
A key part of supply chain management, logistics and inventory management involves planning the movement and storage of goods to ensure timely, accurate delivery to customers.
Larger organizations often face greater challenges, requiring precise control to maintain optimal stock levels. This prevents mismatches and ensures consistent customer satisfaction.
Shipping refers to the physical movement of goods, while logistics ensures that the entire process runs smoothly.

Logistics encompasses everything from planning routes to coordinating deliveries—ensuring shipments are efficient, timely, and cost-effective. For example, food delivery services rely on strong logistics systems to get meals to customers fresh and on time.

Transportation management focuses on planning and executing the most cost-effective movement of goods. It can operate internally or through a third-party logistics provider (3PL) for outsourced fulfillment.

As a key part of supply chain management, it covers all types of freight—domestic, international, inbound, and outbound. Effective transportation logistics requires strategic planning and smart procurement to ensure timely and efficient delivery.

Logistics focuses on planning and organizing the movement of goods, while distribution deals with their physical delivery and placement. Though distinct, both functions work together to enhance supply chain efficiency.
They also align with related activities like warehousing and inventory control—ensuring products reach the right place, at the right time, and at the lowest possible cost.

Refteck Solutions delivers a comprehensive approach to global logistics and supply chain optimisation. Our experts evaluate the entire process to identify cost and efficiency improvements—tailoring solutions to meet your unique operational needs.

We offer customised logistics services including storage, packing, and both domestic and international shipping. With our support, clients can accelerate product delivery, respond quickly to market demands, and improve customer satisfaction.
As your logistics management specialist, we simplify complexity—helping you reduce costs, scale operations, and enhance client experiences.
Here’s what you gain with Refteck Solutions:
End-to-end visibility across your entire logistics and supply chain process
Safe, secure transportation of all cargo—from delicate components to heavy machinery
24/7 customer support for real-time shipment tracking and issue resolution
Significant cost savings through optimisation of bulk material transport and route efficiency
Scalable solutions that grow with your business and adapt to market dynamics

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Spare Parts Procurement and International Logistics

A single missing component can bring your entire operation to a standstill. That’s why it's critical to maintain a steady inventory of the spare parts and resources your business depends on. Taking proactive care of your machinery ensures smoother operations—and ultimately, protects your bottom line. This is where a well-structured Spare Parts Procurement Plan becomes essential—enabling you to anticipate equipment needs and minimize downtime.
But what is spare parts procurement , and why does it matter?

Unlike basic purchasing—which focuses on placing orders, receiving parts, and processing payments— spare parts procurement is a comprehensive strategy. It involves the planning, sourcing, quality checks, logistics, and post-purchase support needed to ensure the right parts are delivered at the right time, every time.
By integrating procurement with international logistics, OFS helps clients maintain continuity, reduce operational risks, and extend the life of critical assets.

At OFS , we deliver efficient, timely, and end-to-end spare parts procurement services. Our logistics and supply chain experts manage the full process—from planning and sourcing to transportation, customs clearance, and storage. With our optimized supply chain strategy, we ensure you receive the right spare parts exactly when you need them.
With OFS as your procurement partner, you can maintain operational continuity and avoid costly downtime with a proactive and well-managed spare parts supply strategy.
Here’s what you gain with our spare parts procurement strategy:
Significant Cost Savings: Thanks to our experienced procurement team and strong vendor relationships.
Faster, Optimized Supply: Designed to eliminate delays and long lead times, ensuring uninterrupted operations.
Customized Solutions: You receive exactly what you need, how you need it. We work closely with vetted suppliers to offer flexible deals and delivery options.
Long-Term Price Stability: Through fixed-price contracts, giving you better financial control and planning.
Our support team is ready 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to handle your inquiry. You can use our enquiry form, email us, or call us.
If you accept the offer, all you have to do is confirm and we'll get started. As soon as your order is sent to the manufacturer, you'll receive a confirmation of receipt.
If you accept the offer, all you have to do is confirm and we'll get started. As soon as your order is sent to the manufacturer, you'll receive a confirmation of receipt.
We'll identify the proper spare part, contact you, and then offer you the best rate.
After the items arrive in our warehouse, an arriving goods inspection is performed to guarantee that the components received correspond to the order and are free of damage.
How OFS Supports You in Spare Parts Procurement

In today’s fast-paced business environment—where efficiency and cost control are critical— OFS brings over 15 years of expertise in global spare parts procurement. Leveraging a trusted international supplier network, we deliver world-class technical support and sourcing solutions to clients across industries.
Our clients benefit from a streamlined, cost-effective procurement process that includes flexible sourcing options and full-spectrum Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) services.

At OFS , we take pride in supplying high-quality equipment and replacement parts at competitive prices. With our reliable procurement solutions, you avoid costly delays and ensure component availability when and where you need it most.

We simplify the entire process—from quotation to final delivery—ensuring transparency, timely updates, and zero surprises. With OFS , your transactions are monitored end-to-end, giving you complete peace of mind.
Partner with OFS—where quality meets reliability in spare parts procurement.

Why Choose OFS for Global MRO Procurement?
Our Approach to Global MRO Procurement
paragraphs: In today’s fast-paced business environment, efficiency isn’t optional—it’s essential. That’s where OFS comes in.

We’re not just streamlining MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) procurement—we’re redefining it. Powered by a global network of trusted suppliers, cutting-edge technology, and a commitment to cost optimisation, OFS delivers smarter, faster, and more strategic procurement solutions.

Say goodbye to supply chain delays and fragmented sourcing. With our holistic approach and data-driven insights, we help you streamline operations, reduce costs, and ensure continuity—across industries, and across borders.
Welcome to the future of MRO procurement. Welcome to OFS.

Join the ranks of successful business leaders who have leveraged One-Off Payments and other specialised services from OFS. Connect with us today to explore how we can help reduce your financial risks and elevate your procurement capabilities.
With OFS as your MRO procurement outsourcing partner, you can confidently navigate the complexities of global procurement—while staying focused on your core business objectives.
Let us help transform your supply chain financing strategy. Contact OFS today and take the first step toward a more efficient, secure, and prosperous future for your business.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Specialized Procurement Solutions for the Oil & Gas Industry

With over a decade of dedicated experience in the oil and gas sector, OFS provides advanced, end-to-end procurement and supply chain management solutions tailored to the dynamic needs of upstream, midstream, and downstream operations. We proudly serve clients across the European and North American markets, offering strategic support to ensure operational continuity and compliance in complex energy environments.

Our core service areas include strategic procurement, project scheduling, cost control, quality assurance, planning and expediting, as well as field and third-party inspections. Each function is executed with precision, ensuring seamless integration with our clients’ project lifecycles and regulatory frameworks.

Our deep industry expertise enhances sourcing efficiency and supplier evaluation—allowing for informed decision-making, stronger negotiations, and long-term value generation. Whether for greenfield developments or ongoing maintenance, our team brings clarity, structure, and agility to procurement processes in high-stakes environments.

We support a wide array of product categories vital to oil and gas operations, including industrial valves, precision drilling tools, centrifugal and positive displacement pumps, MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Operations) supplies, and comprehensive safety equipment. Every component is sourced with a focus on quality, compliance, and performance.

At OFS , we ensure that every product sourced is genuine, competitively priced, and supplied only through proven, reputable manufacturers (OEMs). Our supplier base is fully compliant with all applicable industry regulations and standards—ensuring both safety and performance.

With a skilled, professional team operating across multiple international offices, we are able to provide tailored advice and product recommendations that precisely align with each client’s procurement needs. Our commitment to service excellence makes OFS a trusted partner for reliable, cost-effective, and timely supply chain solutions in the oil and gas industry.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Marine Industry Procurement & Ship Spare Parts Supply

At OFS, we specialize in delivering end-to-end procurement and supply chain solutions for a broad spectrum of ship spare parts and marine equipment, catering to the operational demands of commercial vessels, offshore platforms, and port operations. Our extensive offerings cover a wide array of components, including pumps, motors, filters, cabin fittings, safety and firefighting equipment, desalination systems, marine engines, navigational accessories, and a full range of electrical and mechanical spares.

With deep expertise in the maritime industry, we understand the mission-critical nature of vessel operations and the significant impact that delays or substandard components can have on safety, compliance, and cost. That’s why we are committed to delivering only high-quality, OEM-approved or equivalent parts—ensuring reliability, performance, and regulatory adherence at every stage.

Our global network of trusted marine suppliers and manufacturers allows us to offer competitive pricing and maintain swift turnaround times, regardless of vessel location or logistical complexity. Whether supplying for scheduled dry docks, emergency repairs, or routine maintenance, we work closely with clients to ensure that procurement requirements are fulfilled accurately and efficiently.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Partner with OFS to Build a Sustainable and Green Future
Join us in shaping a cleaner, more sustainable world for the generations to come.

At OFS , we champion innovation and sustainability in the renewable energy sector. As your trusted partner, we support your transition to more efficient and eco-conscious business practices—helping your operations align with the future of green energy.

With the growing global demand for energy and the depletion of natural resources, the shift toward sustainable solutions has become essential. OFS is proud to be part of this movement—leveraging deep expertise to empower renewable energy projects across geothermal, hydroelectric, wind, and solar sectors.
We offer customised, end-to-end solutions that enable businesses to adopt sustainable energy strategies and build eco-friendly operations.

Our experts work closely with renewable energy providers to design, implement, and maintain high-efficiency energy systems. From concept to execution, we help optimise energy output while minimising environmental impact.

OFS is highly skilled in sourcing and procuring critical components such as solar panels, wind turbines, and control systems. We ensure on-time delivery and robust logistics support, so your projects stay on track and on schedule.
Even the best systems need upkeep. Our technicians conduct regular inspections and provide repair services to reduce downtime, increase system longevity, and ensure continued operational efficiency.

With a strong focus on optimising supply chains and sourcing sustainable materials, OFS is your ideal global partner in the renewable energy sector—delivering both local and international support to help you meet your green energy goals.
Let OFS support your next renewable energy initiative and help build a more sustainable future.

Within the power and energy industry, OFS is committed to understanding and fulfilling your procurement needs to ensure reliable operations and consistent performance. Our goal is to help minimise downtime and boost plant efficiency—ultimately increasing megawatt output.

Power generation is a highly complex and critical sector where the demand for electricity continues to rise. To support this, we source and supply spare parts for essential rotary equipment, including:

Our team brings deep technical expertise and industry knowledge, enabling us to deliver tailored procurement services. With value-added offerings such as Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) support, OFS acts as a comprehensive solution provider for the evolving needs of the power and energy sector.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Procurement Solutions for the Petrochemical Industry

The petrochemical industry operates within a complex framework of large-scale projects, critical timelines, and stringent compliance standards—demanding a diverse and reliable supply of equipment and materials to keep operations running smoothly. From high-performance process equipment and electrical instrumentation to gas detectors, HVAC systems, filtration units, valves, and specialized piping components, procurement in this sector is both varied and high-stakes.

At OFS, we provide flexible, scalable, and cost-effective procurement models that address the unique challenges of petrochemical supply chains. Whether it’s sourcing a single niche component or executing a multi-category, turnkey procurement package, we are equipped to support every stage with precision and professionalism. Our global reach allows us to seamlessly handle international logistics, regulatory documentation, and supplier coordination—ensuring timely delivery across borders and project sites.

Our team combines industry-specific knowledge with agile execution to optimize procurement processes while remaining aligned with technical specifications, safety standards, and budgetary requirements. We understand that cost control and reliability are essential, especially when working within narrow project timelines and capital-intensive environments.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
At OFS , we provide high-quality spare parts for critical cement plant equipment—including ball mills, cement kilns, calcining systems, clinker coolers, and other essential machinery.

Our primary focus is to minimize equipment downtime while enhancing the operational efficiency of your manufacturing processes. Leveraging our technical expertise and deep industry knowledge, we aim to deliver comprehensive procurement and supply chain solutions tailored specifically for the cement sector.

By combining our capabilities with value-added MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul) services, OFS is positioned to be a trusted partner for driving performance and reliability across your operations.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Reliable Procurement Solutions for the Mining & Mineral Sector

At OFS, we are recognized for our unwavering commitment to integrity, efficiency, and reliability—qualities that have established us as a trusted procurement partner across the mining and mineral extraction industries. Our proven ability to stock and deliver critical equipment on time ensures that our clients experience minimal operational disruption, even in the most demanding environments.

We specialize in the strategic sourcing and supply of spare parts and equipment essential to a wide range of mining operations. This includes components for bulk material handling systems, surface and underground drill rigs, cranes, draglines, hydraulic and electric shovels, underground loaders, and other heavy-duty mining machinery. Each item is carefully sourced to meet stringent performance, safety, and durability standards, helping our clients maintain continuous output in harsh and high-risk settings.

In the mining sector, where downtime translates directly to financial loss, even minor delays can carry major consequences. That’s why we place utmost importance on timely delivery, coordinated logistics, and accurate order fulfillment. Through a combination of global supplier access and responsive logistics planning, we ensure that the right parts reach the right site—precisely when needed.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Spare Parts & Equipment for Heavy Engineering Projects

At OFS, we offer an extensive and dependable range of spare parts and equipment tailored to the needs of heavy engineering industries, including construction, mining, infrastructure development, and related sectors. Our inventory and procurement capabilities are designed to support critical machinery such as bulldozers, compactors, cranes, drilling rigs, excavators, crushers, and more—ensuring that every component delivered contributes to operational efficiency and project continuity.

Understanding the high stakes and time-sensitive nature of heavy engineering projects, we prioritize the rapid fulfillment of orders and the delivery of quality-assured components that meet or exceed industry standards. Whether for routine maintenance or urgent replacements, our supply solutions are built to minimize downtime and maximize productivity on-site.

Leveraging well-established relationships with a global network of trusted and certified manufacturers, we provide our clients with reliable access to a wide selection of original and compatible parts. These relationships not only enable us to maintain competitive pricing but also allow us to offer flexible lead times and tailored procurement options that suit varying project scales and requirements.

Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
MRO Supply: Your One-Stop Solution for Maximising Efficiency and Minimising Downtime

Welcome to OFS , your one-stop shop for MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) supplies. We are committed to offering top-notch products and services to keep your operations running smoothly. Recognising the critical importance of seamless operations in your industry, OFS provides a full suite of spare parts procurement services—ensuring reduced procurement costs, high-quality standards, and on-time delivery.
WHY OFS FOR YOUR MRO NEEDS?

Economical Solutions: At OFS , we believe that companies, regardless of their size, should have access to high-quality MRO materials at affordable prices. We are your efficient MRO supply chain management partner in sustaining operational excellence, offering competitive pricing without compromising product quality. Moreover, we’re dedicated to building enduring relationships and fostering the growth of your company through value-driven partnerships. Our approach includes aggressive pricing, flexible payment terms, and exclusive offers tailored to your needs.

Outstanding Customer Support: At OFS , your satisfaction is our top priority. Our dedicated support team is always available to assist with your inquiries, provide product recommendations, and address any issues you may encounter. Our success is intertwined with yours. We are committed to continuous improvement, valuing your input, and actively seeking ways to enhance our services and offerings to better meet your evolving needs.
OFS’s MRO Supply Solution: What You Get
Simplify MRO procurement with a single-creditor approach.
Ensure compliance with industry standards effortlessly.
Streamline vendor management and procurement procedures.
Reduce cycle times for faster MRO operations.
Source parts directly from original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).
Guarantee authenticity, quality, and compatibility of parts.
Enjoy negotiated prices and lead time assurances.
Effortless debt management for foreign MRO demands.
Eliminate compliance guesswork in your MRO supply chain.
Unify terms and conditions for consistent compliance everywhere.
Partner for cost-saving spare parts services.
Promise of timely deliveries and affordable shipping.

list_items: Superior Product Quality: At OFS , we curate an extensive and diverse list of MRO supplies. Our meticulous selection procedure ensures that our products, sourced from reliable producers, not only meet but exceed industry standards. Our comprehensive collection serves various industries, offering everything from cutting-edge tools to essential supplies. Explore our catalogue to find the perfect MRO supply solutions tailored to your specific needs.

Tailored Solutions for Every Industry: At OFS , we understand that diverse sectors have unique MRO requirements. That’s why we offer customisable packages, allowing you to select the products and services that align best with your company’s goals. Whether you operate in aerospace, automotive, or any other industry, OFS has the solutions for you. Backed by our team of industry experts, we provide intelligent insights and guidance to cater to your specific MRO needs.

Streamlined Procurement Procedure: At OFS , we offer a user-friendly platform that simplifies the browsing, selection, and purchase of services, enhancing productivity and minimizing downtime. With our commitment to efficient order fulfilment, you can rely on swift order processing and shipping, ensuring your business operations stay on schedule.
Single-Creditor Approach: Need help managing your debt from your foreign MRO demands? OFS guarantees a simple purchase process through its seamless, single-creditor solution.

Assurance of Regulatory Compliance: We are aware of how crucial regulatory compliance is to your business. By guaranteeing that each element of your MRO supply chain complies with the necessary standards and laws, OFS takes the guesswork out of compliance.

Streamlined Vendor Management: Bid farewell to the challenges of handling several vendors with diverse terms and conditions. You’ll benefit from a unified strategy with OFS , which will streamline your procurement procedure and guarantee uniform compliance everywhere.

Quick Cycle Times: Particularly in maintenance and operations, time is money. Reduced cycle times are made possible by OFS’s streamlined processes and knowledgeable sourcing tactics, enabling you to acquire the parts you need precisely when needed.

Purchasing Directly from Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs): You can relax knowing that your parts are acquired directly from the original equipment manufacturers, guaranteeing authenticity, quality, and compatibility with your existing equipment and components.

Guaranteed Lead Times and Bargained Vendor Prices: Take advantage of OFS’s established vendor relationships. You can confidently make plans since we negotiate on your behalf to obtain reasonable pricing and ensure lead times.
Dedicated Spare Parts Services Rely on our specialised support to source spare parts efficiently. OFS is committed to delivering cost-effective solutions for all your MRO needs.
Savings in Indirect Procurement Streamline your procurement process with OFS to achieve significant reductions in indirect costs—eliminate inefficiencies and unnecessary spending.
Optimised Supplier Base Simplify your supply chain by consolidating vendors. With OFS, you get a single trusted source for all MRO supplies.
Lower Transaction Costs Minimise administrative overhead through OFS’s efficient processes and unified approach to procurement.
Efficient Logistics Benefit from OFS’s optimised supply chain operations. We ensure timely delivery and cost-effective logistics through our industry expertise.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Industrial Oil, Chemicals, and Lubricants Suppliers

Rotary equipment refers to mechanical systems that generate kinetic energy to enable movement within industrial operations. Common across the process industry, this category includes devices that move solids, liquids, or gases via a combination of drivers, driven components, and transmission mechanisms.

Rotating equipment is integral to operations involving steam and gas turbines. In such applications, steam turbines act as primary drivers—using high-pressure steam to power equipment like forced or induced-draft fans, pumps, and air compressors. Gas turbines, on the other hand, can either drive generators directly through compressed air or use “scoop tubes” in fluid couplings to transmit energy to rotating components.

Due to the high speeds and pressures involved, operating rotary equipment can pose significant risks. Therefore, strict adherence to safety procedures and regular maintenance are critical to ensure safe and efficient performance.
At OFS , we supply high-quality rotary equipment and components built to meet the rigorous demands of industrial environments—ensuring reliability, performance, and safety in every application.

OFS gas turbines deliver reliable power generation by efficiently converting fuel-air mixtures into electricity through high-temperature combustion. We source premium turbines tailored to client specifications, balancing performance and cost-effectiveness for optimal plant operations.

OFS steam turbines efficiently convert thermal energy into mechanical power for industrial applications, offering both constant and variable speed operation. Our turbines serve as reliable mechanical drives for compressors and pumps, available in scalable sizes to meet diverse process requirements.

OFS compressors deliver precise pressure control for fluids and gases, serving critical roles in refineries and manufacturing. We provide high-quality air compressors that meet strict air quality standards, tailored to meet specific client requirements for optimal performance.

OFS provides a comprehensive range of gearboxes including worm, helical, planetary, and spur designs to modify speed, direction, and torque in mechanical systems. Our precision-engineered gearboxes efficiently amplify rotational force into greater torque, serving as vital components across industrial applications.

OFS reciprocating engines efficiently convert pressure into rotational motion for reliable power generation in industrial and commercial systems. Our robust engines serve as critical backup power solutions while meeting the automation demands of modern process industries.

OFS supplies high-efficiency two-stroke and four-stroke diesel engines, delivering superior thermal performance for industrial and domestic applications. Our modern engines operate with reduced noise, lower maintenance, and greater cost-effectiveness compared to gas-powered alternatives.

OFS delivers precision control systems and instrumentation for accurate process measurement and automation across industries. Our comprehensive range includes meters, regulators, sensors, and control panels optimized for power generation, oil/gas production, marine systems, and agricultural applications.

OFS enhances rotary equipment performance with premium seals, bearings, and drive mechanisms designed to optimize functionality and extend system longevity. Our high-quality accessories allow precise customization of rotary systems to meet specific operational requirements across industries.

Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Industrial Oil, Chemicals, and Lubricants Suppliers

Driven by ongoing technological advancements, market growth depends on substantial investment in manufacturing infrastructure. A key catalyst is the rising global energy demand, which fuels expansion in oil & gas exploration, power generation, and petroleum refining. These sectors, in turn, create strong demand for industrial pumps engineered to meet rigorous standards and specialized applications.

Industrial pumps—available with or without electric motors—are employed to transfer a wide range of media, including chemicals, petroleum products, wastewater, oil, sludge, slurry, and even foodstuffs. At OFS , we source and supply robust pumps and precision-engineered spare parts that exceed our clients’ performance and reliability expectations, ensuring uninterrupted operation even in the most demanding environments.

OFS diaphragm pumps provide reliable fluid transfer solutions for mining, industrial, and hazardous environments where electricity is unavailable. Ideal for handling viscous or flammable materials like fuels, paints, and food-grade liquids, our pumps feature vacuum-assisted operation for flexible mounting positions. These robust pumps excel in explosive atmospheres and challenging dewatering applications while maintaining safe, efficient performance.

OFS centrifugal pumps offer efficient fluid handling with fire, end suction, chopper, and grinder configurations for oil/gas, power plants, and process industries. Their simple maintenance and reversible turbine operation make them ideal for chemical, pharmaceutical, and food processing applications.

OFS hydraulic pumps power heavy machinery across industries, delivering efficient performance for excavators, cranes, and mining equipment. Our range includes durable vane, gear, and piston pumps designed for demanding applications requiring repetitive heavy lifting and precise operation.

OFS vacuum pumps deliver reliable performance for chemical processing and manufacturing applications, including plastic molding, semiconductor production, and glass coating. Our systems safely handle organic solvents while reducing environmental impact and operational costs across industrial processes.

OFS screw pumps (twin and three screw designs) provide reliable solutions for upstream and midstream oil and gas operations. Our vertical screw pumps efficiently handle viscous crude oil, including non-traditional grades requiring diluents or thermal stimulation, ensuring consistent flow from reservoirs to pipelines.

OFS split casing pumps serve as reliable workhorses for industrial and domestic applications, including water treatment, petroleum refining, and mining operations. Our horizontally axially split, single-stage, and double-suction designs efficiently handle water with impurities while ensuring durable performance in demanding environments.

OFS magnetic drive pumps offer leak-proof performance through innovative magnetic coupling technology, eliminating mechanical seals. Our robust pumps handle corrosive, viscous, and hazardous fluids—including chemicals, oils, and wastewater—while withstanding harsh industrial environments with maximum reliability.

OFS industrial oil pumps deliver reliable performance across the oil and gas sector, handling varying viscosities and challenging conditions. Our pumps efficiently manage crude oil—including gas-cut or saltwater-mixed varieties—while maintaining consistent discharge pressure and capacity for optimal operations.

OFS bilge pumps provide critical flood prevention for marine vessels by efficiently emptying bilge wells at regular intervals. Our reliable pumping systems ensure prolonged operational safety at sea, maintaining proper vessel function and engine room protection.

OFS heating pumps optimize industrial energy efficiency by recovering and repurposing waste heat from processes in food production, refineries, and chemical plants. These versatile systems elevate temperatures for reuse while offering reversible cooling capabilities, making them ideal for sustainable temperature management across industries.

Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Resilient Procurement Solutions for the Pharmaceutical & Chemical Industries

Imagine visiting a hospital only to be told that treatment must be delayed for weeks due to a drug shortage—or that the safest, most effective medications for your condition simply aren’t available. Unfortunately, this is no longer a hypothetical situation. It’s a growing reality caused by the fragility of today’s global supply chains.

The chemical sector faces similar challenges. With mounting pricing pressures, rising operational costs, fluctuating demand, inflation, and growing competition, the need for more sustainable and resilient supply chains has never been more urgent. For both the pharmaceutical and chemical industries—where regulatory compliance, product consistency, and supply reliability are critical—procurement is at the heart of operational success.
This is where OFS steps in.

We provide specialized procurement solutions tailored for the pharmaceutical and chemical sectors. From sourcing high-quality raw materials and intermediates to navigating complex compliance requirements, we help ensure our clients' supply chains are robust, cost-effective, and future-ready.

We deliver tailored sourcing strategies based on sector-specific needs—recognising that the sourcing approach for pharmaceuticals may differ significantly from that of chemicals. Our expertise includes:
This enables clients to make informed procurement decisions, control costs, and ensure uninterrupted production.

Our role goes beyond procurement—we take ownership from project initiation to process optimization. We ensure that every material sourced adheres to rigorous pharmaceutical quality control standards, helping clients maintain product integrity, safety, and compliance.
We understand the critical nature of chemical and biopharmaceutical manufacturing projects. Our services are fully aligned with:
By adhering to global and local compliance frameworks, we reduce operational risk and ensure safe, legal, and ethical procurement.
Digital transformation is reshaping procurement. We leverage advanced analytics and tools to provide:
This enables smarter decision-making at every stage of the supply chain.
The pharmaceutical and chemical sectors are constantly evolving. OFS keeps pace with industry changes by offering:
Our goal is to help clients achieve supply chain resilience while meeting long-term sustainability targets.

Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Industrial Oil, Chemicals, and Lubricants Suppliers

Industrial valves play a crucial role across all sectors of the manufacturing industry, particularly in oil and gas, chemical processing, and water management systems. At Refteck, we supply a wide range of industrial valves designed to handle various pressure levels and flow requirements. Our valves are suitable for controlling the movement of gases, liquids, and semi-solids, offering reliable solutions for diverse industrial applications.

A ball valve by OFS is designed to regulate the flow of liquids and gases efficiently. It is available in various body constructions, including one-piece, two-piece, three-piece, and flanged designs. Known for its quick operation, the valve only requires a quarter-turn of the actuator, allowing for instant on/off control. OFS ball valves are built for long-term durability, crafted from robust materials to ensure reliable performance even under demanding conditions.

One of the most widely used valves across industries, the OFS gate valve serves as a reliable on/off switch to start or stop fluid flow. We provide a diverse range of gate valves, including screwed, union, bolted-bonnet, welded-bonnet, and pressure-seal designs.

Operating the valve is simple—turning the wheel raises or lowers the gate, controlling the flow of liquids and gases. While it can assist in fluid regulation, its primary function is to either fully open or completely shut off the flow, making it ideal for isolation applications. OFS gate valves are engineered for durability and precision, ensuring optimal performance in demanding environments.

OFS provides a versatile range of butterfly valves designed for various applications, including chemical processing, HVAC systems, water distribution, agriculture, and heavy industrial plants. These valves feature a compact, rotating circular disk that efficiently regulates flow while maintaining a low-profile design—ideal for installations in tight or confined spaces.

Engineered for reliability and ease of operation, OFS butterfly valves ensure precise flow control with minimal pressure drop. Their lightweight yet durable construction makes them a cost-effective solution for both on/off and throttling applications across multiple industries.

The OFS globe valve delivers precise flow control in pipelines, offering superior shut-off and throttling performance. Unlike ball valves, its unique design allows for fine-tuned regulation, making it ideal for applications requiring accurate flow adjustment.
Engineered for reliability and ease of maintenance, OFS globe valves are commonly used in:

OFS plug valves deliver reliable quarter-turn operation for instant, leak-proof flow control in demanding applications. Combining the quick action of ball valves with enhanced durability, these valves excel in petroleum pipelines, chemical plants, and industrial fluid systems.
Engineered for critical service, OFS plug valves maintain bubble-tight shutoff and smooth performance under high pressures while optimizing flow capacity.

The OFS check valve is an essential one-way valve designed to prevent backflow and protect equipment from damage. By automatically allowing forward flow while blocking reverse flow, it safeguards critical processes across various industries. Our valves are engineered to handle diverse media including liquids, gases, steam, condensate, and semi-liquids like slurries. With reliable performance and durable construction, OFS check valves ensure uninterrupted operation while maintaining system integrity in demanding applications.

The OFS needle valve offers precise flow control for steam, oil, gas, air and other media. Its fine-threaded stem allows gradual flow adjustment, making it ideal for applications requiring accurate regulation at low flow rates. These compact valves excel in critical systems like vacuum equipment and gas lasers where meticulous control is essential. With its ability to provide smooth, incremental shut-off, the OFS needle valve ensures reliable performance in both industrial and precision instrumentation applications.

OFS actuated control valves deliver precision flow regulation for specialized industrial applications, including corrosive liquid handling in chemical plants and critical processes in power transmission systems. These automated valves provide exceptional control accuracy, responding to precise pressure requirements to maintain optimal flow rates. Engineered for demanding environments, our actuated valves combine reliable performance with robust construction, ensuring safe and efficient operation in applications where manual control would be impractical or hazardous. The OFS range offers customizable solutions tailored to meet exact process specifications across various industries.

OFS solenoid valves provide automated, reliable flow control for diverse applications including heating systems, compressed air technology, industrial automation, and swimming pool systems. These electromechanically operated valves enable precise automatic regulation of liquid and gas flow, ensuring efficient system performance. Designed for both speed and durability, OFS solenoid valves offer rapid response times and long service life, making them ideal for applications requiring frequent cycling or remote operation. Their compact design and energy-efficient operation make them a versatile solution for modern fluid control systems across multiple industries.

The OFS safety valve serves as the critical last line of defense for pressure protection systems. Designed to automatically release excess pressure caused by equipment failure or process disruptions, these valves safeguard critical infrastructure in chemical plants, gas storage facilities, and power generation boilers. Our safety valves combine fail-safe operation with precision engineering to maintain system integrity during overpressure events, preventing potential damage or hazardous situations. OFS offers reliable pressure relief solutions that meet stringent industry standards, ensuring optimal protection for your most valuable assets and processes.

OFS pneumatic valves deliver precise control for compressed air systems, ensuring safe and efficient operation across industrial applications. These valves perform three critical functions: pressure regulation, flow control, and directional management of air flow. Available in various sizes and configurations, our pneumatic valves are engineered to meet specific application requirements, from light-duty automation to heavy industrial processes. With their reliable performance and quick response characteristics, OFS pneumatic valves optimize system efficiency while maintaining operational safety in demanding environments.

The OFS pinch valve offers an ideal solution for handling abrasive and corrosive media, particularly in demanding slurry applications. Its simple yet effective design features a flexible sleeve that completely isolates the flow material from mechanical components, eliminating wear and ensuring long service life. As the most maintenance-friendly valve option, our pinch valves provide reliable shut-off even with particulate-laden flows while remaining lightweight for easy installation. OFS pinch valves deliver exceptional performance in mining, wastewater treatment, and chemical processing applications where traditional valves would fail.

The OFS diaphragm valve combines versatility and hygiene for superior flow control in demanding applications. Its unique bidirectional design excels in both precise throttling and reliable on/off functions, making it ideal for industries requiring clean operation. The valve's maintenance-friendly construction allows for easy repairs without pipeline disruption, while its contaminant-free operation ensures product purity in food, pharmaceutical, and ultra-clean processes. OFS diaphragm valves deliver exceptional performance in corrosive, abrasive, or sterile applications where cleanliness and serviceability are paramount.

OFS electric actuators provide a modern, efficient alternative to traditional hydraulic systems by delivering precise, programmable motion control through electric power. These self-contained units eliminate the complexity of hydraulic pumps and tubing while offering superior accuracy and repeatability. Their programmable nature allows for adaptable performance across diverse applications, from precision aerospace systems to industrial automation. With clean operation, reduced maintenance requirements, and the ability to integrate seamlessly with digital control systems, OFS electric actuators represent the future of motion control technology.

OFS provides a comprehensive range of industrial-grade flanges designed to meet strict international standards for plumbing and process applications. Our product line includes welding neck, slip-on, socket weld, lap joint, threaded, and blind flanges, manufactured from high-quality materials like stainless steel, cast iron, brass, and aluminum. These precision-engineered connection solutions ensure leak-proof performance in high-pressure systems while offering easy installation and maintenance. Whether for pipeline construction, industrial equipment, or specialized fluid handling systems, OFS flanges deliver reliable, long-lasting performance tailored to your specific application requirements.

The OFS manifold serves as a critical component in process systems, expertly designed to either combine multiple flows into a single channel or distribute a single flow into multiple branches. Our comprehensive range of manifolds is engineered to meet precise operational requirements, with careful consideration given to pressure ratings, flow characteristics, temperature ranges, and material compatibility. Available in various configurations with optimized port and valve integration options, OFS manifolds provide reliable performance across industrial applications. Whether for complex fluid distribution or streamlined system consolidation, our solutions ensure efficient flow management tailored to your specific process needs.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Catering & Hospitality Services- Serving Quality. Delivering Comfort.

We redefine culinary and hospitality experiences for the offshore, marine, industrial, and corporate sectors. With over a decade of specialized expertise, our Catering & Hospitality Services are designed to deliver nutritious, hygienic, and diverse meals, along with seamless support operations — anytime, anywhere.
Offshore & Marine Catering Fueling Performance at Sea

We deliver high-quality catering solutions to offshore platforms, drilling rigs, ships, and FPSOs, ensuring complete satisfaction for crew and management alike. Our experienced chefs and galley teams ensure:
Balanced nutrition tailored to workforce needs
Special dietary options (Halal, Jain, Vegan, etc.)
Industrial & Remote Site Catering Dependable Nutrition in the Toughest Locations
We serve high-volume, fresh meals at remote industrial camps, oil & gas fields, and construction sites around the world. Our services include:
Packaged meals for rotating shift workers
Onsite kitchen, mess, and canteen management
Corporate & Institutional Catering Daily Dining Made Effortless
We bring flavor and reliability to corporate offices, institutions, and business parks by offering:
Daily employee meal services (lunch, snacks, beverages)
Custom menu plans for MNCs & government bodies
Event catering for meetings, seminars, and special occasions
OHospitality Support Services Comfort Beyond the Kitchen
Our support services extend to all areas of hospitality, providing smooth operations and comfort through:
Room and laundry services for offshore & onshore camps

Serving Global Standards with Local Excellence From Mumbai to the Middle East, and from Kakinada to KSA, we deliver culinary and hospitality services with reliability, care, and cultural sensitivity — maintaining quality and compliance across all geographies.

headings: One-Off Payments: A Smart Solution to Complex Challenges
paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Streamline Your Supply Chain Financing with OFS

In today’s fast-paced global industrial landscape, managing a diverse vendor base—with varying payment terms, currencies, and logistical challenges—can be overwhelming. This is especially true when it comes to the complex, global MRO supply chain.

OFS offers a robust supply chain financing solution designed to simplify and optimise your financial workflows. We understand the operational and financial pressures industries face, and we’re here to provide a seamless, strategic approach that enhances cash flow, reduces administrative burden, and strengthens vendor relationships.

Mastering MRO Complexity: OFS simplifies the intricacies of global MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) procurement through a comprehensive, one-stop-shop approach. We skillfully manage varying currencies and payment terms across geographies to ensure seamless operations—wherever your business is located.

Redefining Supplier Financing: Our supply chain financing solutions are designed to optimise cash flow management. OFS enables businesses to extend supplier payment terms without compromising supplier liquidity—empowering vendors of all sizes with the option for early payments.

Bridging Financial Gaps: OFS helps clients navigate financial challenges by offering extended payment terms while ensuring timely, upfront payments to international suppliers. This approach ensures operational flexibility and strong liquidity in an increasingly competitive market.

Unified Terms, Stronger Partnerships: A cornerstone of our strategy is the ability to streamline capital requests with a unified framework of terms and conditions. By doing so, OFS becomes a reliable financial partner for tier-2 vendors and a strategic enabler for end-users—fostering long-lasting, mutually beneficial relationships.

Your Path to Cash Flow Optimisation: When you partner with OFS for supply chain financing, you gain access to global expertise and a robust financial network focused on boosting your operational efficiency. Our dedicated team works closely with you to develop customised solutions that drive sustainable success.

Our One-Off Payments service is purpose-built to address specific financial hurdles encountered during the procurement lifecycle. These often include accepting non-standard terms and conditions, mitigating foreign exchange risks, and managing pre-financed purchase orders from tier-2 suppliers. OFS handles these risks on your behalf , so you can stay focused on strategic procurement and broader business objectives.

OFS removes ambiguity by ensuring every transaction aligns with your operational preferences and financial policies. With us, you maintain complete control while benefiting from expert handling of contractual fine print.

Navigating global currency fluctuations can be daunting—especially when dealing with overseas suppliers. OFS brings expertise and tools to minimise foreign exchange risk , giving you clarity and stability in cross-border transactions.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
EInventory Planning & Optimisation Solutions by OFS

In today’s fast-paced business landscape, effective inventory planning is key to operational success. At OFS, we understand the challenges companies face in managing inventory efficiently. Our comprehensive solutions are designed to help you take control—reducing costs, improving accuracy, and enhancing overall operational performance.

At OFS, we believe that inventory planning and optimisation solutions should be implemented seamlessly. Our dedicated implementation team works closely with your business to ensure a smooth and efficient onboarding process. We provide comprehensive training and support to equip your team with the skills needed to maximise the value of our advanced inventory management system.

Our commitment doesn't end at go-live—we offer ongoing maintenance, regular check-ins, and prompt assistance to address any issues or concerns. With OFS, you gain a long-term partner invested in your success.

At OFS, we understand that cost-effective solutions are essential for businesses of all sizes. That’s why our pricing structures are flexible and tailored to meet your specific needs. Whether you're a small enterprise or a large corporation, we offer a range of packages to suit your budget.

Our pricing is transparent—no hidden fees, just clear value. Each package is designed to deliver maximum return on investment. Connect with our sales team to explore pricing options and find the package that best fits your business.
We assess, adapt, and enhance your inventory management.
Tailored solutions for your unique business needs.
Empower your team with comprehensive training.
Smooth transitions with hands-on go-live support.
Periodic check-ins for ongoing system optimization.
Unlock the potential of your inventory management.
Customised solutions for your company’s success.
Master your inventory system with expert training.
Seamless transitions with our go-live support.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Streamline your production with OFS Managed Manufacturing Services

At OFS, we provide end-to-end outsourced manufacturing services from India, allowing you to simplify production without compromising on quality or timelines. From concept and design to final delivery, we ensure your products are built to precise specifications — efficiently and reliably.

Our services function as a natural extension of your manufacturing operations, giving you the freedom to focus on innovation and growth. Based in India, we handle the complexities of production to deliver high-quality, custom-built products that align with your exact requirements.

We specialize in manufacturing a broad spectrum of products — from parts and components to machinery, consumables, and engineered goods. Whether supporting capital expenditure projects or supplying components for OEMs, our advanced facilities in India are equipped to meet a wide range of manufacturing demands.
What is the cost of this service?
Our transparent pricing structure covers raw material procurement, manufacturing, management, and logistics, ensuring no hidden costs or surprises for OEMs.

Our services are ideal for OEMs looking to outsource manufacturing and expand their production footprint. Partnering with us in India gives you access to a highly skilled workforce and cost-efficient manufacturing solutions.
Look no further! We take complete ownership of your manufacturing from concept to design to delivery!
Years of service experience in the industry
Why choose us as your outsourcing manufacturing partner.
We manage the entire production process from initial design to final delivery, guaranteeing consistency and precision every step of the way.
Our strong network of suppliers and global logistics partners enables smooth and seamless integration into your supply chain.
WOur manufacturing facilities in India comply with international certifications and undergo rigorous testing to meet high quality standards.
Tap into our network of over 400 industry experts for comprehensive design and engineering support.
We ensure transparent communication with real-time updates and proactive problem-solving.
Our decentralized supply model, combined with centralized oversight, protects your intellectual property at every stage.

Global Industry Leaders in India Companies like Boeing, Apple, Siemens, Daimler, Bosch, Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, BASF, and Baumer have established manufacturing units in India, capitalizing on the country’s advantages.
Diverse Manufacturing Base India produces a wide array of products, from electric vehicles and heavy machinery to chemicals and appliances.
Skilled Talent Pool With the world’s youngest population, India adds approximately 1.5 million engineers to its workforce annually.

Geopolitical Stability As the host of the 2023 G20 summit and with recent trade agreements with Australia and the United Arab Emirates, India offers a stable and conducive environment for manufacturing.
Our core team features leading engineering talent from India’s top institutions, including the Indian Institutes of Technology.
We invest in cutting-edge machinery and Industry 4.0 technologies to drive precision and foster innovation.
Partnering with us offers substantial cost benefits and a dependable manufacturing relationship.
We deliver fast production cycles, providing quotes within 1–2 days and completing production in just 15–25 days.

Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Strategic Sourcing & MRO Data Enrichment Solutions

OFS delivers cutting-edge strategic sourcing and MRO data enrichment solutions designed to elevate your MRO operations. Our expert team helps you reduce costs, enhance quality and efficiency, mitigate risks, and make data-driven decisions. By optimising procurement processes and enriching critical data, OFS empowers businesses to operate smarter, faster, and more competitively.
Sourcing the right components and services is critical—but far from simple. Businesses face several obstacles in their pursuit of sourcing excellence:
Identifying Reliable Suppliers: Locating dependable, consistent vendors who meet quality and delivery standards remains a major challenge.
Ensuring Product Quality: Without robust quality checks, poor-quality inputs can lead to disruptions, defects, and increased costs.
Time-Intensive Operations: The sourcing lifecycle—from supplier discovery to onboarding and evaluation—is often manual and resource-draining.
Complex Negotiations: Navigating pricing structures, payment terms, and contract conditions requires both time and expertise.
Cost Control Pressures: Striking the balance between competitive pricing and uncompromised quality is an ongoing concern.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring that all sourced materials and suppliers comply with local and international standards is vital to avoid legal and operational risks.
Finding the Most Reliable Sources of Supply

Data-Driven Decision Making: Effective sourcing begins with accurate, actionable data. At OFS, we leverage advanced technologies to enrich your MRO data, converting it into strategic insights that drive smarter procurement decisions.

Customised Sourcing Strategies: Every organisation has its procurement challenges. OFS works closely with your team to understand your goals and pain points, crafting sourcing strategies tailored to your operational and financial objectives.

Supplier Management Excellence: Our experienced sourcing professionals identify and evaluate suppliers based on quality, reliability, cost, and lead time. More than just transactional, OFS builds strong supplier partnerships through performance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Compliance Assurance: OFS ensures your sourcing practices align with all relevant legal and regulatory requirements. Our experts remain current with evolving compliance frameworks, helping you mitigate legal risks and maintain operational integrity.

Data Enrichment with AI: Using AI and machine learning, OFS enhances and cleans your MRO data to provide sharper visibility and reliable insights. This enables informed, data-backed sourcing decisions that improve efficiency and reduce costs.
Custom solutions tailored to your needs.

Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management

Outsourced Procurement involves engaging a third-party organization to manage and deliver procurement services on your behalf. By choosing this approach, businesses gain immediate access to skilled procurement professionals with deep industry knowledge and expertise.

Outsourcing eliminates the need to build and train an internal team from scratch—saving valuable time and resources. It also ensures that procurement activities are managed efficiently and strategically, allowing internal teams to focus on core business functions while benefiting from best-in-class procurement practices.
Outsourced procurement can be a strategic solution in various scenarios. It is especially beneficial when:

Internal Capabilities Are Limited : When an organization lacks in-house procurement expertise but needs quick access to procurement benefits such as cost savings, supplier management, and contract oversight.

Selective Outsourcing is Needed : When internal procurement teams exist but support is required for specific categories—particularly indirect materials and services—outsourcing provides targeted expertise without overextending internal resources.

Procurement is Non-Core : When procurement is not viewed as a core or strategic function, outsourcing allows companies to focus on their primary business objectives while entrusting procurement to specialized providers.

Rapid Procurement Development is a Priority : When businesses aim to build procurement capabilities quickly to realize immediate savings, outsourcing can serve as a launchpad—providing a foundation that can be gradually transitioned to an internal function over time.
Procurement outsourcing can be categorized into two main types, each serving distinct business needs:

Direct Procurement Direct procurement involves the sourcing of raw materials, components, and goods directly tied to a company’s core production processes. These purchases are often made in bulk and focus on securing the best combination of cost, quality, and reliability from a pool of trusted suppliers. Example: A manufacturing firm may outsource its direct procurement to a specialized provider capable of sourcing essential raw materials efficiently and cost-effectively to ensure continuous production.

Indirect Procurement Indirect procurement focuses on acquiring goods and services that support day-to-day business operations but are not directly involved in the production of finished goods. These include internal services such as IT support, HR, marketing, maintenance, and logistics. Example: A company might outsource the procurement of office supplies, facility management, or IT services to streamline operations and reduce overhead costs.
Outsourcing procurement offers a range of strategic and operational advantages for businesses looking to streamline processes and boost efficiency:

Reduced Supplier and Invoice Workload Outsourcing can dramatically reduce the time and effort required to manage suppliers and process invoices—potentially cutting this workload by up to 80%. This allows businesses to focus internal resources where they matter most.

More Time for Strategic Purchasing By shifting routine procurement tasks to external specialists, businesses can dedicate more time and attention to high-value, strategic purchases. This is particularly beneficial for organizations that need to prioritize core operations or make swift, informed procurement decisions.

Access to Procurement Expertise Outsourced providers bring deep knowledge in areas such as strategic sourcing, contract negotiation, and supplier relationship management. This gives companies access to high-level capabilities that might be lacking internally—without the need to build a full in-house team.

Agile Procurement Function Outsourcing supports the development of a flexible, responsive procurement function that can quickly adapt to shifting market conditions. This agility is especially valuable in fast-changing industries where speed and adaptability are essential.

Improved Focus and Operational Efficiency Delegating specific procurement tasks—like supplier identification or contract management—enables internal teams to reassess their roles and focus on key sourcing initiatives. This leads to greater efficiency and a more strategically aligned procurement function.
Allow the Experts to Handle the Procurement

Outsourcing procurement is a powerful strategy to relieve your business from the complexities of procurement management—while boosting efficiency and sharpening strategic focus. By delegating essential tasks to seasoned professionals, you free up valuable time and resources to concentrate on your core business priorities.

Whether it's securing the best pricing, mitigating fraud risks, or building a more agile and responsive procurement function, outsourcing paves the way for measurable performance improvements and cost savings.

Embark on a journey toward smarter procurement. Connect with the OFS team for a complimentary consultation and discover how our expertise can help streamline your procurement processes, protect your resources, and accelerate your business success.
