Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
ELEVATE YOUR OPERATIONS WITH GLOBAL MRO PROCUREMENT EXCELLENCE
In today’s fast-paced business environment, efficiency isn’t optional—it’s essential. That’s where OFS comes in.

We’re not just streamlining MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) procurement—we’re redefining it. Powered by a global network of trusted suppliers, cutting-edge technology, and a commitment to cost optimisation, OFS delivers smarter, faster, and more strategic procurement solutions.

Say goodbye to supply chain delays and fragmented sourcing. With our holistic approach and data-driven insights, we help you streamline operations, reduce costs, and ensure continuity—across industries, and across borders.
Welcome to the future of MRO procurement. Welcome to OFS.
Why Choose OFS for Global MRO Procurement?
Our Approach to Global MRO Procurement

Join the ranks of successful business leaders who have leveraged One-Off Payments and other specialised services from OFS. Connect with us today to explore how we can help reduce your financial risks and elevate your procurement capabilities.
With OFS as your MRO procurement outsourcing partner, you can confidently navigate the complexities of global procurement—while staying focused on your core business objectives.
Let us help transform your supply chain financing strategy. Contact OFS today and take the first step toward a more efficient, secure, and prosperous future for your business.
Access diverse products through our global supplier network.
Optimise costs with tailored strategies and quality control.
Efficient procurement made easy with our user-friendly platform.
Automate processes for streamlined and productive procurement.
Empower your strategy with data-driven insights.
Forecast demand, plan strategically, and manage inventory effectively.
Our global network brings a world of products to your doorstep.
Cost-effective procurement strategies customised for your success.
Simplify your procurement process with our automation solutions.
Data-driven insights for informed and efficient decision-making.
Boost profitability with lower purchase costs and overhead.
Efficiency gains lead to uninterrupted operations.
Proactively manage risks for business continuity.

Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Industrial Oil, Chemicals, and Lubricants Suppliers
Industrial Oil, Chemicals, and Lubricants Suppliers

Industrial oils, chemicals, and lubricants play a critical role in the process industry. Industrial oils are used in a wide range of machinery and vehicles, available in various types such as gear oils, air compressor oils, hydraulic oils, rock drill oils, turbine oils, and low-toxicity oils. Chemicals are often blended to enhance fuel efficiency and protect equipment from corrosion, contributing to improved performance and longevity.

Lubricants are essential for minimizing friction between moving surfaces—particularly in rotary equipment—ensuring smooth and efficient machinery operation. Commonly used lubricants include motor oils, marine oils, silicone-based lubricants, greases, turbine oils, metalworking fluids, cutting and grinding fluids, farming oils, gas engine oils, brake fluids, and hydraulic oils.

Lubricating grease is a semi-solid lubricant made by blending mineral oil with a soap-based thickener. Unlike liquid lubricants, it doesn't flow easily, which allows it to cling effectively to moving parts. Its consistency makes it easy to apply, provides excellent sealing capabilities, and ensures long-lasting performance. Due to its reliability and versatility, lubricating grease is widely used across industries such as construction, agriculture, oil and gas, and chemical processing.
OFS offers a comprehensive selection of grease guns designed for professional lubrication applications. Our range includes:
Pistol grip designs for enhanced control
Hand grip options for precision applications

We understand that proper lubrication requires the right tools. That's why our grease guns are engineered to deliver precise amounts of lubrication - typically 1-3 grams per stroke - ensuring optimal performance while minimizing waste.

Today, approximately 75% of manufactured chemicals are used to produce essential goods—from detergents and soaps to perfumes and beyond. Industrial oils serve as the backbone of modern industry, powering energy generation, heating homes and businesses, and fueling global transportation networks, including automotive and aviation sectors.
At OFS , we specialize in supplying a comprehensive range of high-quality industrial oils and chemicals, meticulously selected to meet our clients' precise operational requirements.

OFS is a trusted supplier of high-performance industrial grease, offering a wide range of products tailored for diverse applications. Our premium industrial grease oils deliver superior lubrication, protecting machinery from friction, wear, and extreme operating conditions. As a leading industrial grease supplier , we provide advanced industrial grease lubricants engineered to enhance equipment efficiency, minimize downtime, and extend service life.
Discover the right grease solution for your needs—contact OFS today for reliable, high-quality lubrication products.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Industrial Oil, Chemicals, and Lubricants Suppliers
Reliable Drilling Equipment & Spare Parts for Global Operations

Drilling equipment is a critical component across both land and offshore markets, especially in mineral exploration, geothermal drilling, construction, and water well drilling. These drill rigs operate on every continent and play a vital role in shaping the future of energy and infrastructure development.

At OFS , we specialise in sourcing and supplying high-performance drilling equipment and spare parts trusted by industry leaders around the world. Our partnerships with OEMs known for rugged reliability and minimal maintenance allow us to provide top-tier equipment tailored for:
We support a wide range of drill rig models and applications, ensuring that our clients receive the exact components they need—on time and within budget.

What sets OFS apart is not only our product quality but also our unmatched MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) support. Our experienced team ensures that your rigs remain operational, efficient, and productive, reducing downtime and increasing performance in the most demanding environments.

Draw works is the main hoisting system in rotary drilling rigs, made up of the drum, brakes, transmission, and cathead. At OFS , we supply top-quality spare parts trusted across the domestic, Middle Eastern, and Southeast Asian markets. Our durable components ensure smooth drilling operations, and our responsive service ensures a streamlined procurement experience tailored to your needs.

OFS supplies high-quality travelling blocks and spare parts from trusted manufacturers. These pulley systems are essential for lifting and lowering heavy loads in the wellbore. We also offer multiple sheave units and custom-engineered designs tailored to meet specific project needs, from standard models to fully bespoke solutions.

OFS supplies stainless steel seamless and welded coiled tubing for petrochemical, oil & gas, natural gas, and geothermal industries. Available in nickel, titanium, duplex, and other special alloys, our tubing meets both standard and custom specifications, backed by extensive industry experience.

OFS offers a full range of rugged and reliable oilfield instruments—from pressure gauges to complete systems—designed for today’s toughest drilling environments. We help you select cost-effective, high-quality tools, backed by dedicated support.

Power generators are essential in the oil and gas industry, providing reliable energy to support drilling and excavation. These generators ensure uninterrupted power for heavy equipment, making them vital for smooth and efficient operations.

Wireline equipment uses braided and electrical cables for well intervention, evaluation, and maintenance in oil and gas operations. These systems help operators lower tools and instruments into the wellbore to assess and manage conditions. Refteck supplies advanced wireline equipment designed to withstand extreme environments, including pressures over 30,000 psi and temperatures up to 500°F in geothermal wells.

Completion tools are used to bring oil and gas wells into production after drilling. They support safe and efficient hydrocarbon extraction during well completion. Refteck offers a full range of completion tools, including open-hole and cemented multi-stage stimulation systems, composite plugs, and critical components like wellheads, tubing hangers, safety valves, ESPs, and more—ensuring reliable performance from test to commercial production.

Oil tools are essential equipment used during drilling, completion, and well intervention activities to optimise production and maintain consistent reservoir flow. Refteck supplies a range of downhole tools designed to reduce operational costs, extend well life, and improve oil recovery. These tools support operations like fishing, cementing, casing, well measurements, and reservoir fracturing, ensuring smooth and efficient well management.

Power Swivels are hydraulic motor-driven machines used to rotate drill pipes during operations such as oil and gas well drilling, water wells, offshore platform piling, and foundation construction. Refteck offers a wide range of high-performance power swivel systems, known for their safety, reliability, and adaptability to various drilling needs.

Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Your Strategic Partner for All Industrial Procurement Needs

Successful project execution hinges on timely access to the right materials, efficient resource planning, and expert coordination. At OFS , we are committed to being your trusted partner in achieving operational and project excellence.

Through our comprehensive Project Supply Solutions , we empower you to streamline procurement and logistics from concept to completion. In the complex landscape of project management and industrial supply chains, OFS delivers end-to-end support tailored to ensure your success—on time and within budget.
Our Approach: Embedding Excellence at Every Stage

At OFS, we deliver a comprehensive approach to project supply management, focusing on precision, performance, and reliability. Our goal is to ensure your projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Tailored Solutions for Complex Projects Each project comes with unique challenges. That’s why we avoid a one-size-fits-all model. Our experts take time to understand your project’s scope, industry needs, and constraints. From sourcing specialised materials to managing logistics and risks, we align our solutions with your goals.

Seamless Collaboration and Communication Project delays often result from poor communication. At OFS, we prioritise clarity and transparency, working closely with your team to keep all stakeholders aligned. This eliminates bottlenecks, fosters accountability, and builds trust.

Optimised Supply Chain Efficiency Our experts enhance procurement efficiency—from supplier selection to inventory and delivery. By cutting waste, shortening lead times, and improving resource use, we help reduce costs and drive project success.
Proactive Risk Management Every project has uncertainties. OFS equips you with proactive risk strategies and contingency plans that ensure continuity—even during unexpected challenges.

Sustainability and Ethical Practices We believe in responsible project execution. OFS integrates sustainable and ethical sourcing across the supply chain—protecting the environment and enhancing your project’s reputation.
Join the OFS Project Supply Revolution

Embark on a transformative journey in project supply management with OFS as your trusted partner. Our team of experts is equipped to ensure the flawless execution your projects demand. With a client-focused approach, a strong commitment to sustainable practices, and a forward-thinking mindset driven by technological innovation, OFS is your gateway to turning vision into reality. Let us help you achieve excellence—every step of the way.

Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Master Data Management: Elevate Your Business’s Data with Ease

Welcome to OFS’s Master Data Management Hub —your gateway to streamlined data governance in today’s data-driven world. Our Master Data Management (MDM) solution empowers businesses to take full control of their critical data, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and trust across all systems.

What is Master Data Management (MDM)? MDM is the practice of creating and maintaining a single, accurate, and comprehensive source of essential business data—such as customer information, product details, and financial records. By centralising this data, MDM eliminates duplication and inconsistency, enabling every department to access reliable, up-to-date information effortlessly.
Refteck’s Master Data Management (MDM) system has delivered measurable impact across industries. Real-world case studies reveal how our clients have benefited from:
“Efficiency Boost: Streamlined data management for better business operations.”
“Data-Driven Decisions: Master data for smarter choices and higher profits.”
“Customer-Centric Success: Elevating customer interactions with reliable data.”
“Expert Guidance: Tailored MDM solutions to meet your unique needs.”
“Industry Know-How: Our specialists bring sector-specific knowledge.”
“Customised Solutions: Collaborating closely to match your demands.”
“Proven Success: Successful MDM deployments across sectors.”
“End-to-End Support: We’re with you from start to finish.”
“Seamless Experience: Ensuring your impactful MDM journey.”
“Refteck’s MDM: Your partner for efficiency and customer excellence.”
“Ready to transform? Start with a consultation.”
“Contact us now to elevate your business.”

Centralised Master Data Storage Refined data is consolidated into a single, authoritative repository—providing a consistent “single source of truth” for your entire organisation.
Governance and Security Robust governance capabilities allow you to define roles and access permissions, ensuring sensitive data is secure and only accessible by authorised personnel.
Monitoring and Maintenance Ongoing data monitoring ensures quality and relevance. Any discrepancies are proactively flagged and corrected for continuous integrity.
Seamless Data Distribution Your master data is accessible across departments and platforms, supporting better decision-making and cross-functional collaboration.
Seamless Integration Our MDM solution integrates effortlessly with your existing systems—ERP, CRM, or other platforms—ensuring a consistent and smooth data flow across your organisation.
Unmatched Data Quality Eliminate errors and inconsistencies with advanced data validation and cleansing tools. Make confident, data-driven decisions backed by reliable, high-quality information.

Enterprise-Grade Security & Compliance Your data is protected with industry-leading encryption, role-based access controls, and full compliance with global data standards.
Scalable for Growth As your business grows, so does your data. Our platform scales effortlessly to support your expanding needs—without compromising on speed or performance.
Enhanced Efficiency Eliminated data silos and streamlined workflows through a single, consistent data source—boosting operational performance.

paragraphs: Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Plant Maintenance & MRO Spare Parts Management
Procurement Solutions for the Manufacturing Industry

At OFS, we specialize in providing customized procurement solutions tailored to the evolving needs of clients across a wide spectrum of general manufacturing sectors. From steel and automotive to food processing, textiles, fertilizers, and beyond, we understand the complexities and challenges unique to each industry and deliver solutions that drive operational efficiency and competitive advantage.

With over ten years of industry experience, OFS has cultivated a robust global supply network and forged strong, dependable relationships with internationally certified vendors and manufacturers. This enables us to offer seamless access to high-quality components, equipment, and materials that meet rigorous health, safety, and environmental standards. Our approach emphasizes the adoption of forward-thinking technologies that support cleaner production processes and promote long-term sustainability.

Our expert team works in close partnership with every client to assess their operational objectives, regulatory requirements, and market demands. We then craft cost-effective, scalable procurement strategies that align with their long-term business goals—enhancing reliability, reducing downtime, and optimizing resource allocation.
